overview: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter based in India. We supply premium spray dried Litchi powder designed for industrial food and beverage formulations. Manufactured from carefully selected fruit, our powder features a fine 80-100 mesh size and low moisture under 5 percent. This ensures smooth solubility, uniform texture, and consistent performance across production runs.

Our standardized six-step process spans sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch. We support international importers and brand owners with bulk supply, OEM capabilities, and private label solutions. Every consignment includes export documentation support to ensure seamless international transit. The powder delivers an 18 to 24 month shelf life when stored correctly.
highlights: Spray dried fine powder with 80-100 mesh size
Stable shelf life of 18 to 24 months
Free-flowing texture with high solubility in liquid bases
Consistent batch-to-batch color and fruit profile
applications: Functional beverage formulations and powdered drink mixes
Confectionery fillings, gummies, and hard candies
Dairy products including yogurts and flavored milks
Bakery items, cake mixes, and fruit pastries
Ice creams, sorbets, and frozen desserts
Dry seasoning blends and fruit syrups
packaging: 25 kg bulk bags and HDPE containers

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Litchi powder?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 5 Kg for standard orders, supporting both pilot trials and commercial production runs.

faqs.q: What are the primary technical specifications of this powder?
faqs.a: The product is spray dried with a particle size of 80-100 mesh and moisture levels maintained below 5 percent.

faqs.q: Can TradeNest Naturals provide private label packaging?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer comprehensive OEM and private label services, including custom pouches, jars, and tailored mesh sizes.

faqs.q: Are product samples available prior to commercial ordering?
faqs.a: We provide evaluation samples upon request to assist with formulation development and factory trials.

faqs.q: What shelf life and storage conditions apply to this ingredient?
faqs.a: The powder maintains quality for 18 to 24 months when kept in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you provide export documentation for overseas shipments?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we furnish export documentation to support smooth customs clearance for international buyers.
